woom WOW — New!

Great things start wobbly.

Balancing has never been more intuitive. Carefully crafted for toddlers learning to walk, the self-balancing woom WOW supports early development of key motor skills and builds confidence. Its safety-conscious design, paired with self-centering steering, offers the perfect balance between stability and mobility. Prepare for WOW moments as your babies turn into toddlers with every ride.

For kids 9 - 36 months. Designed to safely inspire confidence and support early development.

Shop woom WOW

woom GO

Little bike. Big love.

The woom GO collection features an innovative progression of two balance bikes and four pedal bikes, specifically crafted for beginners. From the new colors on each model, to the redesigned saddle and grips on the GO 1, to the child-friendly gear indicator on the GO 4 – each model has been refined to provide a safe, easy, and intuitive riding experience for the youngest children, and grow with the rider as they improve their skills.


For kids 1.5 - 8 yrs. Perfect for learning, everyday casual rides, and light trails.

Shop woom GO

woom EXPLORE

Less scrolling. More exploring.


Created with adventures in mind, the woom EXPLORE is the ultimate mixed-terrain bike for young Riders ready to push boundaries. With all-terrain tires, disc brakes, and a sporty frame, this bike handles light trails and gravel with ease. It features our latest ergonomic improvements, a more angular frame, wider tires for better traction, and enhanced shifting for smooth gear changes. The woom EXPLORE is the next step for kids who are ready to take their riding experience further.


For kids 6 - 14 yrs. Made for everyday riding, light trails, and gravel adventures.

Shop woom EXPLORE

woom OFF & OFF AIR

Nothing is OFF limits.


With the superlight and durable woom OFF and woom OFF AIR, youngsters can ignite their stoke levels with reliable off-road bikes offering them lots of fun, easy handling, powerful braking, and total control. Select a fork in the trail: either a rigid fork (OFF) or an air suspension fork (OFF AIR) - and off you go!

For kids 6 - 14 yrs. Designed for off-road, gravel, rocky trails, and rugged outdoor adventures.

Shop woom OFF & OFF AIR
